propositions: Batch-path overlap verdicts systematically carry confidence=0.0 despite successful judge_batch execution, causing aggregate filtering to reject all pairs below the 0.7 threshold
Output token limit of 1024 truncates multi-candidate batches (K up to 20 candidates), causing the entire batch to abstain rather than return partial results
JSON schema for batch entries lacked required fields (candidate_id, relation, confidence, abstain), allowing the model to omit confidence or malform multi-entry structures
Near-duplicate pairs with identical artifacts and paraphrased titles should surface as findings but are silently filtered out due to the stacked defects
The single-candidate overlap case continues to work correctly, masking the batch path failures in unit tests that use canned runners
